blockers: No local IdP container is available in docker-compose.live.yml.
OIDC_ISSUER / OIDC_JWKS_URL are unset and Keycloak client secrets are placeholders.
A real enterprise SSO/OIDC tenant and client credentials are required to validate login/logout, group/role mapping, and audit events.
notes: This is an environment-dependent P0 gate. Evidence cannot be produced in the local Docker staging surrogate without an external or containerized identity provider.
The repository contains Clerk-based auth wiring and an SSO incident runbook; no code changes are required to enable SSO once a provider is configured.
Recommendation: complete this gate in the approved staging environment with a configured Keycloak or Clerk enterprise connection before Core GA sign-off.
